description: Look inside a file without converting it – use it first when you do not know what a file is or what can be done with it. Returns: "format" (the real format, from the content when the extension is wrong or missing), "extension_matches", size, mime, "properties" (depending on the kind: pages, page size, fonts and not-embedded fonts, whether a PDF has a text layer; words, sheets, slides, author, title; image size, camera, GPS; duration and audio/video streams; archive entries; e-book and font metadata; text encoding, lines, CSV columns; "language"), "warnings" (password_protected, signed, macros, javascript, embedded_files, missing_fonts, scanned, gps_location, tracked_changes, comments, hidden_sheets, external_links, executable_inside, executable, extension_mismatch, high_compression, drm, unreadable) and "targets" (the most common formats it converts to; targets_total = all). Input like convert: "url", "text" + "filename" or "data_base64" + "filename". Does not count toward the conversion limits (own limit 120 per hour). Errors: invalid_arguments, file_too_large, download_failed, busy, limit_reached, node_unavailable.

data_base64.description: Small binary file as base64 (tens of kB, hard limit 2 MB).

filename.description: File name for "text" / "data_base64", e.g. "report.md" – the extension helps; without it the format is detected from the content (text with no recognisable format is plain text).

from.description: Source format id, only when it cannot be told from the file name extension – e.g. a URL like download.php?id=5. Otherwise leave it out.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the file.

name: inspect
title: Inspect a file
